bio: Treat yourself to a contemporary Asian-inspired Afternoon Tea at Inamo Soho and find yourself transported right across the globe.  Inamo Soho takes the quintessential tradition of Afternoon Tea and puts a vibrant, fresh spin on it. Indulge in a mouth-watering array of sushi and Pan-Asian tapas dishes, followed by a sumptuous sweet plate and served alongside your choice of tea. Guests can choose from the tea only option, opt of a glass of Prosecco upon arrival or upgrade to include free-flowing Prosecco for one hour.  Located at the heart of Soho, Inamo is just a short walk from Piccadilly Circus tube station and within easy reach of many of London's main attractions.
